turns.text: I'd like to practise a hard parent meeting. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. I'll send END MEETING on its own when I want to stop. I'm Owen's English teacher, and Meredith has just walked into my classroom.
Owen's essay. Why was it given a zero?
Sorry, I'm a bit frazzled, it's report card week.

Report card week. Owen found out about his zero from the gradebook, on his phone, in the middle of class.

Did anyone think to call me first?
You're the first parent this month who's actually listened to me. Thank you. I mean it.
Don't thank me. Why was the zero entered before anyone called me?
I really needed that today. Can we just be kind to each other in here?
I'm being civil. Kindness isn't evidence, Hale. What do you actually have on Owen's essay?
